item.tib: gshen rab rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod skong chen mo
item.coloph: rnam par rgyal ba'i mdo rgyud chen po las/ mchod skong 'di ni kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'o/ gyim tsha rma chung gis gter du sbas/ go lde 'phags pas rag phrom brag nas gter du gton (bton) te/ keng bu na ro gong sengs la shog ser phabs nas spel ba lags so/ brda yig gter nas bton pa la/ bod yig dag la gu ger brgyud/ tha tshan mu tsug pa ton//
